referencePolicy: Repository ranch references informed only the warm Sonoran palette, material language, and child-friendly mood. No reference image is shipped or used at runtime.
commonPrompt: Create one original, friendly 2D storybook ranch-patio prop for Essma World. Warm Sonoran afternoon light, tactile adobe-ranch materials, strong readable silhouette, three-quarter view matching the supplied production ranch background. Isolated on a solid chroma-key background. No characters, logos, branding, letters, ratings, copied composition, or imitation of a named studio.
postProcess: Chroma-key removal, transparent-edge inspection, placement on a 768px transparent runtime canvas, then derived 256px thumbnail.

qa.note: Release-candidate art pending final in-game product review and any external cultural review.
